gloss: to be biased; to lean toward; to be uneven

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {偏|かたよ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be biased; to be partial
definitions.explanation: to favor one side unfairly; to have a one-sided view or approach

definitions.gloss: to lean; to be uneven; to be lopsided
definitions.explanation: to be physically off-center or concentrated on one side

notes:
{偏|かたよ}る means to be biased or physically uneven.

FORMS:
- {偏|かたよ}る (dictionary form)
- {偏|かたよ}った (past/attributive - "biased")
- ⟦{偏|かたよ}り→偏り：05774_katayori⟧ (noun form - "bias, unevenness")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{偏|かたよ}る (opinions are biased)
- ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{偏|かたよ}る (nutrition is unbalanced)
- {偏|かたよ}った⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧ (biased view)
- {偏|かたよ}った⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧ (unbalanced diet)
- ⟦{偏|かたよ}り→偏り：05774_katayori⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without bias, evenly)

NOUN FORM {偏|かたよ}り:
- ⟦{偏|かたよ}り→偏り：05774_katayori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is bias)
- ⟦{偏|かたよ}り→偏り：05774_katayori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくす (to eliminate bias)

TRANSITIVITY:

- {偏|かたよ}らせる is the transitive/causative form

RELATED WORDS:

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday and formal contexts.
